text:
olivia: Heads-up — I hit a few live requests where the router fell back to a variant that doesn't support tool-calls and has a shorter context window. App crashed downstream. We need a quick compatibility audit and some telemetry around mismatches.

raj: Oof. Can you paste an example request/trace?

olivia: Trace snippet attached (sanitized). Router selected rwd-7b-q4_sp as fallback for a rwd-7b-q4_bpe request because of capacity. The fallback lacked tool_call support and the prompt exceeded 4096.

sam: Quick summary: our routing only checks 'family' + quantization compat, not feature parity (tokenizer/tool_call/max_ctx). That explains it.

maria: We definitely need a capability model in the catalog. Right now entries are just names + perf profiles. Add explicit flags: tokenizer, max_ctx, tool_call, kv_cache_compat, function_calling_version.

raj: Agree. Minimal matrix I want in the catalog API:
```csv
variant,tokenizer,max_ctx,tool_call,kv_cache
rwd-7b-q4_bpe,bpe,2048,yes,compat_v1
rwd-7b-q4_sp,spiece,4096,no,compat_v1
rwd-13b-fp16,bpe,8192,yes,compat_v2
```

sam: Router change: before choosing fallback we should filter candidates by capability mask. Pseudocode:
```js
const candidates = pool.filter(v => v.max_ctx >= req.context_len && v.tool_call === req.needs_tool_call && tokenizer_compatible(req.tokenizer, v.tokenizer));
if (candidates.length === 0) fallback_to_degraded_path();
```

olivia: tokenizer_compatible is messy. We need a matrix for BPE <-> SentencePiece edge-cases (special tokens, byte offsets). For now, conservative: only match identical tokenizer family or a pre-approved conversion path.

maria: Telemetry: log these tags on every routed request:
- requested_variant
- served_variant
- fallback_reason (capacity|latency|region|tier)
- tokenizer_mismatch (true/false)
- truncated_due_to_ctx (true/false)

infra-bot: deploy job queued: feature/catalog-capabilities -> staging at 1768454600 by ci-bot :rocket:

raj: Console UX: add a per-route "fallback parity" panel showing percent of requests that hit a variant lacking required features, and sample traces. Also show cost delta and avg latency delta when fallback occurs.

jen: For rollouts, canary policy should include a parity check gate: if canary falls back > X% for a critical route, auto-stop rollout. We should expose X per-customer tier (free/dev/prod).

sam: Quota/behavior decision: for high-tier customers, prefer capacity or cross-region rather than a degraded fallback. For free tier, fallback is fine but should mark the response with a warning header.

olivia: Action items I can take this sprint:
1) Add capability fields to model catalog and a compatibility matrix (PR: catalog/#432).
2) Instrument router to check capability_mask and emit telemetry (PR: router/#907).
3) Add console panel prototype for parity metrics (dashboard/#21).

raj: I'll own the tokenizer conversion policy doc and add a list of allowed conversions + token-offset sanity checks.

maria: I'll own telemetry ingestion and define the schema in events.catalog_fallback (include sample event schema).

jen: I'll wire up the rollout gating config in the console and default thresholds per tier.

olivia: Nice. One more: add a small regression test to evals that runs prompts exercising tool-calls and long context across variants to catch silent parity regressions.

sam: +1. If we log both requested_variant and served_variant this becomes easy to chart.

olivia: Cool — I'll start the catalog PR and drop a link when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
